notes.title: Driving Is Hard - Driving Is Insane Update! v5.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Driving Is Hard – Driving Is Insane Update! V5.0[/h1]
We went full throttle with this one. A brand new hard mode, slick skins, and big under-the-hood improvements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45180705/f2c8b17a5c49c466e5a80f60d233e66a7829d0a4.gif[/img]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Insane Mode[/b] – new no parachute gamemode with a few checkpoints. Driving Is Hard must be completed to play this.
[*] [b]New Skins[/b] – Unlockable lootbox and completion achievement skins.
[*] [b]Discord Button[/b] – Found a bug? Smash that button.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Fully rewritten loading system[/b] – loads a bit slower, but uses way less memory and makes future updates tiny.
[*] [b]Better & more unstuck points[/b] (though getting stuck should be close to impossible).
[*] [b]Removed all Father voice lines.[/b]
[*] [b]~10% FPS boost[/b]
[*] [b]Localization polish[/b] – improved localization texts
[/list]


[h1]Community Spotlight 🐐[/h1]
A huge thank you to the organizers and players who put together a chill Driving Is Hard showmatch featuring 4 GOATs of the game! Pitrau, Warryan, Miztix, Lockness.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45180705/00d7a389642977a0efe4e3fbd51ef4fa0eb03343.png[/img]

Pulling off a clean run isn’t easy—mad respect to the drivers. 💪 Thanks for showing the game some love!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45180705/f3682d01f4928cff503bef6de3cadbe9fd66c623.png[/img]

notes.title: Driving Is Hard - Skin Update! v4.0 🎨
notes.notes:
[h1]Driving Is Hard - Skin Update! v4.0[/h1]
Jeff is getting a makeover! This update introduces [b]bath and character customization[/b], letting you collect and equip [b]cool new skins[/b] while tackling the toughest roads.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45180705/be752bbc3af75515d183a260a3082ccdd3ad8fe8.gif[/img]

[h2]New Feature - Collectible Skins![/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Customize Jeff[/b] with unique outfits and accessories.
[*] [b]Explore the world[/b] to find hidden collectibles scattered across different levels.
[*] [b]Show off your style[/b] as you struggle and succeed through brutal driving challenges!
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Reflections[/b] - Improved reflection quality and made the metals look better
[*] [b]Sounds[/b] - Improve sounds all over the map
[*] [b]Ragdoll[/b] - Make Jeff react to external forces more
[*] [b]Steam Deck[/b] - made the UI larger and default visual settings Potato for better first-hand experience
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Ghost Flip[/b] - Fixed the ghost flip which used to happen at the apex of the jump.
[*] [b]Resolve Stucks[/b] - We had two locations where people stucked. Now we don’t.
[*] [b]Flickering Trees[/b] - Fix a few trees that caused visual flickers.
[/list]

Update your game and start [b]hunting for skins![/b] Whether you drive in [b]style or chaos[/b], the challenge remains the same - [b]Driving Is Hard[/b].

🚗💨 [b]Happy driving![/b]

notes.title: Driving Is Hard – Driving is Easy Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45180705/7e18ba1d97818f53f6fe2da301bb7aac53241d67.png[/img]

[h1]Driving Is Hard – Driving is Easy Update![/h1]
We’ve been busy under the hood, and we’re excited to bring you an update packed with new features, improvements, and fixes!

[h3]Driving Is Easy Mode[/h3]
A new, more forgiving game mode for those who want less pain and more fun!
Set checkpoints by toggling lanterns and respawn after crashes.
Perfect for players who want to enjoy the wild ride without the brutal challenge.

[h3]Quality-of-Life Settings[/h3]
[b]Auto Rotation[/b] – Toggle automatic camera rotation to keep your cam aligned.
[b]Speedlines[/b] – Turn speed lines on or off based on your style.
[b]Dynamic FOV[/b] – Toggle dynamic field-of-view whenever you like.
[b]Restart Button[/b] – Add a restart button for quicker resets—great for speedrunners!

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[b]Improved Credits Screen [/b]- Added Respawn Counter and Grandpa Race Track statistics.
[b]Performance Boost[/b] - Potato settings now deliver even better performance for low-end machines.

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[b]Speedrun Areas[/b] - Patched a few sneaky shortcuts in the Treehouse and City Rooftops.
[b]Linux Glitches[/b] - Visual glitches on Potato settings have been resolved.
[b]Tree Flickering[/b] - Trees no longer flicker—enjoy a glitch-free view of nature!

:fire: Update your game and try out the new Driving Is Easy mode! And don’t worry—Driving Is Hard is still as punishing as ever for those who seek the challenge.
Happy driving! :wheel::bathtub:

notes.title: 🚗 Driving Is Hard – OUT NOW on Steam! 🏁
notes.notes:
The wait is over! Driving Is Hard is now available on Steam! 🎉

Take control of Jeff, a determined (and half-naked) man driving an old bathtub uphill through brutal, unforgiving terrain. Every move matters – balance too much, and you tumble down. Go too fast, and chaos unfolds.

What to Expect:
✔ Foddian-style gameplay – Climb higher, fall lower, repeat.
✔ Precision physics driving – Skill matters, and mistakes are costly.
✔ Brutally rewarding challenges – Every fall is a lesson.
✔ A hilarious and emotional journey – Get roasted by Jeff’s father as you struggle.
✔ Streamer-friendly content – Watch (or be) the one to suffer.

Do you have what it takes to reach the top?

notes.title: Bathtub Car Setup on GameOn 2024!
notes.notes:
🎉 We Just Rocked GameOn 2024 with A Difficult Game About Driving! 🚗🛁

Hey everyone! We just got back from GameOn 2024, the biggest gaming expo in the Baltics, and it was unforgettable! We went all out to make our booth as immersive as possible by bringing a real-life bathtub car setup, complete with a wheel, to let fans experience the game like Jeff himself!

GameOn is all about pushing the boundaries between virtual and physical, and we couldn’t think of a better place to showcase A Difficult Game About Driving. Thank you to everyone who stopped by, tried out our setup, and shared laughs with us. It was amazing to see players react to the game's challenging climbs, hilarious falls, and all the memorable moments!

Check out some of the photos from our setup below and stay tuned for more updates. If you missed GameOn, don’t worry—there’s plenty more in store!

🛠️ Keep driving (and maybe falling)! 🛠️
